name: Spot gold and silver CFDs, which follow COMEX's Globex week
source: COMEX Globex hours in New York time: Sunday to Friday 18:00 to 17:00 with a daily break from 17:00 to 18:00; shut with Globex on Christmas Day and New Year's Day; on Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents' Day metals halt at 13:30 Chicago (14:30 New York) and reopen at 18:00 New York, as Dukascopy's XAUUSD bars show on 2025-01-20 and 2025-02-17; other early closes are not modelled in version 1; in 2027 Christmas Day and New Year's Day both fall on a Saturday, and the observed-day hours are left out until CME publishes them
